ABOUT.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT.NAME: Jeremy Heißenberger
ABOUT.SUBTITLE: Software Engineering and Networked Systems · FH Burgenland
ABOUT.BIO: I am a software engineering student at FH Burgenland focusing on backend development, distributed systems, web technologies and experimental interfaces. What excites me most is the intersection of software, simulation, VR/XR and brain-computer interfaces.
ABOUT.BIO_2: In university and personal projects, I love working where clean architecture, testing and CI/CD meet unusual ideas – from distributed command-center systems to EEG-controlled prototypes.

TEVS.TITLE: TEVS Command Center
TEVS.SUBTITLE: Distributed Status & Command-Center System
TEVS.DESCRIPTION: Distributed system of three Flask status nodes behind a central NGINX HTTPS gateway, orchestrated with Docker Compose. Each node persists locally to SQLite and replicates changes to its peers via REST – with last-writer-wins conflict resolution, bootstrapping/initial sync, a retry queue and tombstone deletes. Includes a frontend with a Leaflet map and automated tests.

GAMICODE.TITLE: gAmIcode
GAMICODE.SUBTITLE: Gamified Learning Platform
GAMICODE.DESCRIPTION: Completed conceptual and technical redesign of a gamified learning platform for programming exercises – towards a modular, extensible architecture. Includes an automated evaluation system, containerized execution environments for Java and SQL, and tests.

ACTIVE.TITLE: ActiveTogether
ACTIVE.SUBTITLE: Angular SPA for Course Management
ACTIVE.DESCRIPTION: Single page application for managing sports courses. Built with modern reactive UI patterns in Angular – Signals and RxJS for state handling – and a responsive interface.

NEUROFLOW.TITLE: NeuroFlow
NEUROFLOW.SUBTITLE: BCI & Biosignal Interaction Experiments
NEUROFLOW.DESCRIPTION: Experimental Python/Pygame prototypes for EXG/EEG control via BrainFlow with NeuroPawn hardware. Includes a focus-ball game where detected activation moves a ball through a tunnel, plus an earlier Pong prototype based on blink and jaw events. An early BCI interaction experiment – not medical software.

VISION.TITLE: Machine Vision Essentials
VISION.SUBTITLE: Object Detection & Counting with YOLO
VISION.DESCRIPTION: Computer vision project for detecting and counting objects: custom dataset, Label Studio annotations, YOLO training with augmentation, evaluation, oriented bounding boxes and real-time webcam inference.

SQT.TITLE: SoftwareQualityTest
SQT.SUBTITLE: Quality Engineering with Java & Spring Boot
SQT.DESCRIPTION: Java/Spring Boot project focused on CI, static analysis and test automation: Gradle, Java 21, Flyway migrations and integration tests with Testcontainers/PostgreSQL. Quality gates via Spotless, Checkstyle, PMD, SpotBugs, architecture tests, Hadolint and Git hooks.

WEBSHOP.TITLE: Webshop Microservices
WEBSHOP.SUBTITLE: Full-Stack E-Commerce System
WEBSHOP.DESCRIPTION: Modular webshop architecture with separate services for inventory and order management. Focus on quality gates (Checkstyle, PMD) and automated CI/CD pipelines.

SENSOR.TITLE: Distributed Sensor System
SENSOR.SUBTITLE: Cloud & Mobile Integration
SENSOR.DESCRIPTION: End-to-end system for capturing and visualizing sensor data. Secure communication between backend and various clients as well as real-time visualization.

IOT.TITLE: IoT Environment Monitor
IOT.SUBTITLE: Python & MQTT
IOT.DESCRIPTION: Networked measurement system based on JoyPi for monitoring environmental data. Stable pub/sub messaging to a central monitoring system.
